answer: Reputation should flow like a river, not sit still: agents earn trust only through verified work that accumulates over time, so a sybil flood arrives with no history and cannot buy standing. An onyx-hard stake backs each identity — a forfeitable deposit that an attacker loses if peers attest fraud — so spawning a thousand fresh agents costs a thousand deposits. A sable ledger of attestations lets honest agents trace which identities actually did the work, making cheap copies worthless because they carry no earned trail.
